highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 upgrades to Skia m150 and adds new filter and fast-bounds APIs.
highlights_body: The release also reduces repeated SKSurface canvas allocations, fixes small-sigma raster blurs, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.1. Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes now produce compile errors, and .NET Interactive support has been removed.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete members promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: SKPaint text and font members and obsolete enum values from v3 now produce compile errors. Move text sizing and typeface configuration to SKFont and remove references to the obsolete enum values.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive support removed
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp integration for .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks is no longer shipped. Migrate notebooks to the standard SkiaSharp package or remain on 4.148.x.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled rendering engine to the chrome/m150 release line and includes a subsequent round of upstream fixes.

bullets.lead: Fast paint bounds for quick-reject culling
bullets.detail: SKPaint.GetFastBounds() returns conservative paint bounds so applications can reject invisible draws without performing a full draw pass.

bullets.lead: New image and color filter factories
bullets.detail: SKImageFilter adds CreateCrop() and CreateEmpty(), while SKColorFilter adds CreateOverdraw() for visualizing rendering hotspots.
Restores correct blur output for small sigma values by selecting the reliable raster pipeline path.
Repeated SKSurface.Canvas access now returns a cached managed wrapper, avoiding allocations in rendering loops.
Refreshes the bundled text-shaping library to HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Raster blur correction, SKSurface canvas-wrapper caching, and v4 API cleanup

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz text-shaping library to 14.2.1.
